== Summary ==
Exact crop of the published Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side), PDF page 27: the slip of [[Rebel Sacrifice (Errata 3)]] (official text as of 27 April 2013; PDF built February 2014), cropped at 300 dpi. It prints errata version PC-E3 (“Deploy on table if Obi-Wan 'communing.' "Tatooine" on Obi-Wan is treated as "Death Star." Your Death Star sites gain one [Light Side], and if opponent loses Force to battle damage (or a Force drain) at such sites, stack the first card lost face-down here. Attack Run is canceled. (Immune to Alter.)”).<ref>[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Master List (Light Side)]]. Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

* '''Not an official image file.''' Crop made 11 November 2026 for batch C2/C3 (swccg-guild/work#236). Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
